card.title: Apologize to Reality
card.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to our inn. Please apologise to the doorway for knocking after you arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It expected advance notice from your knuckles. Explain that you're sorry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for telling the telephone first. It had to hear about its own visitor secondhand.

mechanism: A makes an inn guest apologize to a doorway for impossible advance notice and then for giving another object priority.
confusable: Unlike ordinary arrival etiquette, the offended doorway must require actions impossible to satisfy in the normal sequence.
comparison: A phone call becomes an insult to the doorway, rather than the chair scene's standing remedy becoming unemployment.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
